say: Meet our demo household. Park Yung-hee, seventy-six, lives alone in Los Angeles. Her children live in Seoul and Seattle.
caption: Meet our demo household. Park Young-hee, 76, lives alone in Los Angeles. Her children live in Seoul and Seattle.

say: Chin-goo Care A.I. makes her TV the care hub.
caption: Chingu Care AI makes her TV the care hub.

say: One press on the remote starts today's check-in.
caption: One press on the remote starts today's check-in.

say: She answers the way she would answer a friend. Press OK, and talk.
caption: She answers the way she would answer a friend. Press OK, and talk.

say: Or she picks an answer with the remote. The A.I. writes these three for this moment.
caption: Or she picks an answer with the remote. The AI writes these three for this moment.

say: When she's done, her family gets a short note, written by A.I. Never the conversation itself.
caption: When she's done, her family gets a short note, written by AI. Never the conversation itself.

say: Jee-woo reads it in Seoul, next to when the TV came on, and the morning the hub has learned from two weeks of her mom's TV.
caption: Ji-woo reads it in Seoul, next to when the TV came on, and the morning the hub has learned from two weeks of her mom's TV.

say: Postcards from the family play on the big screen.
caption: Postcards from the family play on the big screen.

say: When it's time for her blood pressure tablet, the reminder pauses the video, and waits for her.
caption: When it's time for her blood pressure tablet, the reminder pauses the video and waits for her.

say: One press. The video carries on, and the family sees the dose.
caption: One press. The video carries on, and the family sees the dose.

say: Jee-woo can write straight back to the TV.
caption: Ji-woo can write straight back to the TV.

say: Every sentence she says is checked for an emergency, by a phrase list and a second model.
caption: Every sentence she says is checked for an emergency, by a phrase list and a second model.

say: Chin-goo Care A.I. tells her to call nine one one, and alerts her family at once. It is not a medical device, and says so.
caption: Chingu Care AI tells her to call 911 and alerts her family at once. It is not a medical device, and says so.

say: Under the hood: React Native for Fire OS, a small Python hub, and any open A.I. compatible model.
caption: Under the hood: React Native for Fire OS, a small Python hub, and any OpenAI-compatible model.

say: The TV building blocks are a separate open source kit, M.I.T. licensed, with tests.
caption: The TV building blocks are a separate open-source kit, MIT-licensed, with tests.

say: Chin-goo Care A.I. launched on Android phones on October twentieth. The TV app is new for this hackathon.
caption: Chingu Care AI launched on Android phones on 20 October. The TV app is new for this hackathon.

say: Chin-goo Care A.I. Apart, but always near.
caption: Chingu Care AI. Apart, but always near.
